name: Achieving Top Inference Performance with the NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPU and NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM
notes: NVIDIA developer blog comparing DGX H100 (8x H100 80GB HBM3) with TensorRT-LLM v0.5.0 (batch-1 point) and v0.6.1 (latency-threshold points) against AMD's MI300X launch claims for Llama 2 70B. Figure 1 is an SVG chart; the only figures stated in prose are 1.7 s per inference at batch 1 and >5 inferences/s at a 2.5 s fixed response-time budget. Full build.py and gptSessionBenchmark command lines are published.
